description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink Open Source Project. It handles displaying revision details of requirement specifications, initializing necessary components, managing user permissions, and rendering a Smarty template for the requirement spec revision view.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic empty class used for flexible object property assignment.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument parameters for the script, including test project info and user ID.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI component with requirement item details, user rights, and configuration data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions to access the requirement specifications page based on rights.
